dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, thin-lined 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp transitions from dark centers to bright perimeters, concentrated along the dorsal ridge with jagged outer perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, bright, amorphous pixel clusters without gradients, localized primarily near the anterior neck region and scattered sparsely along the lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle, while a secondary chain of smaller blobs forms a roughly horizontal linear arrangement along the mid-lateral line.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex network of interconnected, light-colored vermiculations creates a reticulated or marbled pattern across the central dorsal-lateral surface.
